purpose: Teach: アタマ/境地/ワザ/実話/唖然/シリアス/ファイト/頭上

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アタマ良すぎだぞ
lines.en: Riku, you're way too smart for your own good.
lines.style: Warm, open-faced admiration. Quick attack, no hesitation. Playful but genuine underneath — the kind of compliment a friend lands by not making it a big deal.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、悟りの境地に達したような顔してたな、桜
lines.en: You had this look on your face like you'd reached enlightenment or something, Sakura.
lines.style: Light, teasing half-smile in the voice. Wry observation delivered without bite. Pace stays casual — not mocking, just calling her out with warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカーのワザがすごいな
lines.en: Riku, your soccer skills are seriously impressive.
lines.style: Direct, genuine praise. Quick and straightforward — no cushioning or performance. The voice of someone noticing something real and naming it without ceremony.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、実話の本ハマってたな、桜
lines.en: You were totally into those true-crime books the other day, weren't you?
lines.style: Curious observation, gently teasing. Leans in slightly. Interested in what she noticed about him. Soft, wondering tone — not accusatory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト結果に唖然としてたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw your face when you got those test results back.
lines.style: Dry, knowing smirk in the delivery. Relaxed pace. Calling him out for a reaction he tried to hide. Friendly wryness, not unkind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、シリアスな映画ばっか観てたな、桜
lines.en: You've been watching nothing but serious movies lately, haven't you?
lines.style: Light amusement, gentle ribbing. Even pace, no judgment. The tone of someone noticing a pattern and finding it quietly funny.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ファイト!応援するぞ
lines.en: Riku, you've got this — I'm cheering for you.
lines.style: Bright, genuine encouragement. Warm opening. Steady conviction underneath. The voice of someone who means what she says and isn't embarrassed to say it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、頭上を見上げて何見てたんだ?桜
lines.en: What were you looking up at just now, Sakura? What did you see?
lines.style: Curious, gentle. Close attention — noticing she was watching something. Soft, wondering tone. Not pushing, just asking because he genuinely wants to know.
